corridor_notes: Source (taohuren.com, citing the 2011-11 project announcement) describes this as '宜兴支线' (the Yixing branch): '工程起点为金坛市薛埠镇...终点为我市高塍镇','高塍分输站'; route passes through '金坛市朱林、儒林以及我市新建、官林' (Zhulin & Rulin towns in Jintan, then Xinjian & Guanlin towns in Yixing). Length ~55km, diameter 610mm, ~3.2 billion RMB investment, construction started Nov 2011, adds 300 million m3/yr Sichuan-gas capacity to Yixing. Same article separately notes a later 'Jinwu pipeline phase 2' project through Heqiao and Wanshi towns (~33km) -- relevant context for P7558's 'Jinwu Pipeline' naming, but a distinct project, not part of this route. Xuebu Distribution Station is independently confirmed as a real hub on the Jiangsu trunk network -- it is also the named start of Section A of the 218km trunk (see P7542's ref, jsaeit.com), which corroborates Xuebu as a genuine branch point feeding multiple downstream lines including one toward Yixing.
researcher_notes: CAUTION - flag for human review: GEM lists this row's endpoints as StartLocation=Liyang / EndLocation=Yixing with LengthMergedKm=31.00 ('Liyi Branch, Liyang-Yixing'). The only sourced Yixing-directed branch found in Chinese-language search starts at Xuebu Town, Jintan (not Liyang) and is ~55km, not 31km. Xuebu (Jintan) is adjacent to/borders Liyang and both are under Changzhou prefecture, which may explain GEM's 'Liyang' simplification, but the length mismatch (55 vs 31km) is unresolved -- this could be (a) the same branch with GEM's length wrong/outdated, (b) GEM's 31km covering only part of the 55km branch, or (c) a genuinely different, unfound 'Liyi'-specific segment. No dedicated '溧宜' (Liyi) branch article was found despite multiple targeted searches; this is the best/only candidate located. Endpoint place names and coordinates are solid (verified station-level source); the PID-to-segment mapping is the open question.
blockers: Length discrepancy (source: ~55km; GEM: 31km) and start-city discrepancy (source: Xuebu/Jintan; GEM: Liyang) not resolved -- see researcher_notes. WebSearch tool budget for the session was exhausted (200/200) partway through this PID's research; remaining searches used DuckDuckGo/Sogou/Bing via WebFetch as a substitute, which is less reliable and CAPTCHA-prone, so a dedicated 溧宜-branch source may simply not have been found rather than not existing.
